notes: Fixes drawings saved with the web app's display path ("/files/drawings/x.png") instead of the storage path ("drawings/x.png"). Those rows made the server look for <storage>/files/files/drawings/... which does not exist, flooding the log with ENOENT 404s and hiding the images from the mobile app — roughly 9% of drawings on a live clinic database. Paths are now normalised on save (including inside TEXT_MODE values) and existing rows are repaired automatically on startup, across visit drawings, attachments, patient records and previous investigations. The startup log reports how many references were repaired.
